description: This file implements the RequestHandler class for managing lifecycle and window/ripple handlers within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes initialization, termination, and request handling methods, as well as external dependencies and class definitions related to lifecycle management.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing lifecycle requests, window, ripple, and runtime handlers within the plugin framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RequestHandler with service and event handler, setting up ripple, runtime, and window managers.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up all handlers managed by RequestHandler.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Attempts to launch an application with a specified lifecycle state.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Requests termination of an application, optionally forcing the termination.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to the application identified by the context.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle state of the application.

methods.name: getRuntimeManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the runtime manager handler instance.

methods.name: getWindowManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the window manager handler instance.
